$schema_note: Structured mirror of CROSS_REPO_STATUS.md's repository roster (see docs/adr/ADR-011-ecosystem-dashboard.md). This file is the Dashboard's extensibility point: add a repo here, the Dashboard picks it up on the next aggregation run, no Dashboard code change required. Not a source of truth in itself -- it restates facts already recorded in prose docs and must be kept in sync with them by whoever edits either.

repos.name: Velisa
repos.role: Architecture, registry/ library, ecosystem state documents. Describes the others; nothing depends on it at runtime.

repos.name: video-production-agent
repos.role: Orchestrator: Observation -> Inference -> Decision -> Plan -> Project IR -> Validation -> Execute -> QA -> Report/Provenance. Consumes all 10 Skills below.

repos.name: ffmpeg-skill
repos.role: Execution foundation: 21 base tools wrapping FFmpeg/ffprobe directly. Every delegating Skill depends on it.

repos.name: video-editing-skill
repos.role: Editing operations (trim, concat, ...), delegates execution to ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: audio-production-skill
repos.role: Audio processing, delegates execution to ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: color-grading-skill
repos.role: Colour operations (HDR to SDR, LUT apply, retag, strip Dolby Vision, primary correction), delegates execution to ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: subtitle-skill
repos.role: Subtitle generate/render (SRT/WebVTT); burn-in only delegates to ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: motion-graphics-skill
repos.role: Titles, lower-thirds, overlays, corner bug/chapter elements. Delegates execution to ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: thumbnail-skill
repos.role: Thumbnail render/extract. Frame decode delegates to ffmpeg-skill; compositing is in-process (Pillow).

repos.name: qc-skill
repos.role: Deterministic quality-control / delivery-gate checks. Talks to ffmpeg/ffprobe directly, not through ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: media-analysis-skill
repos.role: Media measurement/observation. Talks to ffmpeg/ffprobe directly, not through ffmpeg-skill.

repos.name: transcription-skill
repos.role: Speech-to-text via local ASR engines (faster-whisper etc.), not FFmpeg-based.

repos.name: dubbing-skill
repos.role: TTS, voice replacement, fitting translated lines to source timing, audio description. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: publish-skill
repos.role: Upload and metadata for delivery platforms; owner of platform delivery specs. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: detection-skill
repos.role: Face, text (OCR) and object detection. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: slide-sync-skill
repos.role: Slide import, slide-change detection, slide text. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: imagemagick-skill
repos.role: Still-image editing with ImageMagick (formerly image-skill). Not consumed by video-production-agent.

repos.name: nle-bridge-skill
repos.role: Timeline interchange with Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve: OTIO / FCP7 XML / CMX3600 EDL + SRT export, conform packages with relink manifests, beat-grid markers, and a diff of the editor's changes. v0.1 merged 2026-10-31 (nle-bridge-skill#1).

repos.name: blender-skill
repos.role: Headless Blender: inspect, convert, optimize and render 3D assets.

repos.name: artifacts-skill
repos.role: Verifies AI-generated documents and issues evidence-backed receipts.

repos.name: stepcap
repos.role: Screen recording of a task into a how-to guide and a SKILL.md.

repos.name: bdmvkit
repos.role: Optional install. Blu-ray (BDMV) authoring library.

repos.name: vtskit
repos.role: Optional install. DVD-Video (VIDEO_TS) authoring library.

repos.name: udfkit
repos.role: Optional install. UDF disc image writer for DVD-Video and Blu-ray.

repos.name: dvdcc
repos.role: Optional install. Line-21 closed captions (CEA-608) for DVD MPEG-2.

repos.name: oncemore
repos.role: Optional install. DVD and Blu-ray authoring app (Mac).

repos.name: voice-enhance-skill
repos.role: AI voice isolation, dereverberation and mic-bleed reduction for recorded speech. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: sound-design-skill
repos.role: BGM and sound-effect generation (ACE-Step 1.5). Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: diarization-skill
repos.role: Speaker diarization: fills the Transcript speaker_id. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.

repos.name: remotion-ffmpeg-skill
repos.role: Remotion motion graphics on real footage, timed from ffmpeg-skill measurements.

repos.name: hyperframes-skill
repos.role: Renders HTML scenes to verified video with HyperFrames.

repos.name: skillpact
repos.role: Machine-readable skill contracts: side effects, conformance tests, signatures.

repos.name: system-intelligence
repos.role: Read-only ecosystem auditing (si diagnose); feeds the Control Room.

repos.name: ingest-skill
repos.role: Media offload with checksum-verified copies, dual backup and a clip inventory. Repository created 2026-10-29; no package yet.
